title: Water and drought in Kitui
description: Kitui has the lowest share of any county in Kenya with at least basic drinking-water service.
notes: 21% basic drinking-water service is the lowest of any county (KDHS 2022).
NDMA moved Kitui from Alert to Normal by August 2026, while listing it among counties where conditions are getting worse.

values.label: NDMA drought phase · Feb 2026
values.note: Alert. Average water trekking distance in Kitui was 7.2 km, the longest among semi-arid counties, tied with Lamu .

values.label: NDMA drought phase · Aug 2026
values.note: Kitui classed Normal, but listed among counties where conditions are getting worse, with El Niño rains expected .

values.label: Basic drinking-water service · 2022
values.note: 21% — lowest share of any county in Kenya
